question: How should an evidence row cite text that a page renders only after a click? The Wolfram|Alpha API FAQ shows questions only, and its answers sit in the page's JavaScript text bundle (a build-hashed asset under /_next/static/chunks/).
why: The FAQ answers that give the 2,000 free calls a month, no raw-data export and no data download are cited from that bundle, whose URL changes with each build of the site; a later verify run cannot re-read the cited URL and has to find the new bundle from the FAQ page.
